description:
Pure generated-skill consumer updates currently classify as code because `.claude/skills/**`, `skill-sync.yaml`, and `skill-sync.lock` are in the binary code/content path model. The 2026-08-14 profile measures full refreshes at 80.4-83.7 successful runner-minutes and 27.0-31.4 minutes to merge-unblock, although BenchBox runtime code neither imports nor executes these artifacts. Add a first-class specialized classifier bucket and a required `skill-integrity` job that validates trusted source/target policy, immutable pins, lock/mirror equality, instruction authority, focused wrapper contracts, artifact hygiene, and commit identity. Preserve full CI for unknown, empty, self-editing, mixed product, and structural trust-boundary diffs; keep `ci-required-result` and strict-current-base policy unchanged.

Path names alone are insufficient when `skill-sync.yaml` changes. The `ci-paths` decision must compare the head manifest with `git show <base>:skill-sync.yaml` through one deterministic policy parser. Missing/unparseable base or head input fails closed to `needs_code_ci=true`. A ref-only change remains eligible for the narrow lane only when every source URL, source name, subdir, target root, install mode, selected skill, and override mapping is unchanged and approved, and every new ref is a full immutable commit SHA. Any structural change to those fields, or any policy-module edit, selects full CI; the skill lane also runs when skill paths changed. Tests must cover ref-only, structural, parse-failure, missing-base, and mixed cases.

The independently fixed verifier pin is owned by BenchBox maintainers. Advance it when the supported skill-sync lock/config schema or the approved product CLI pin changes, or when the current verifier can no longer verify a valid lock. Every advancement must update the policy/docs/tests together, repeat the empty-HOME clean-runner clone/build/verify proof, and run full CI; it must never be inferred from the PR-edited manifest. Also correct the live false-coverage claim that `pr.yml` already contains `guard-skill-sync-verify`; it does not. Clean-runner feasibility for the initial pin is proven in `/tmp/skill-sync-clean-runner-spike.log`.

Moving-head compatibility is bound by `_project/decisions/behind-pr-occurrence-2026-08-16.md`: keep strict current-base checks, `ci-required-result` as the required umbrella, one-at-a-time `make pr-refresh`, and `make pr-ready` as the only normal auto-merge arm path. The implementation PR intentionally runs full CI. If it becomes BEHIND, refresh only that PR; do not enable an auto-updater, refresh all open PRs, silently merge inside `pr-open`, or use `READY=1` at open unless the branch is actually final. This item must not unblock or implement strict-base-refresh 07a reduced-refresh modes or 07b `merge_group` support.

In GitHub Actions, every changed-path and semantic manifest decision must bind to immutable `${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}` and the same event head/merge identity used by certification; it must never classify against a newly fetched mutable `origin/develop` tip. Local pre-open classification may use current `origin/develop`, after which publication remains subject to the ancestry gate from `behind-pr-occurrence-01-pr-open-currency`. Regression coverage must model event base A followed by `origin/develop` advancing to B: path classification, manifest comparison, and certification stay on A, while GitHub may correctly mark the PR BEHIND.

Skill-only successful runs emit an explicit non-full `certification_kind`. Do not modify `scripts/pr_refresh_certification.py::pred_prior_full_checks` to accept it as `CERTIFICATION_FULL`; an exact refresh whose prior parent is skill-only must remain fail-closed with `prior_certification_not_full`. Full product/mixed runs may emit full certification only after all selected product and skill requirements pass. Required context names remain unchanged.
